from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class OtherPayablesItem(BaseModel):
    """The 'other payables' (其他应付款) reported in one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name this report belongs to")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="Securities/trading code if provided")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The other payables amount reported")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the amount, typically 'CNY' or 'yuan'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g. '2024年Q1' or 'Q1 2024')")
    balance_type: str | None = Field(description="Whether this is the ending/beginning balance (e.g. '期末余额')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim line containing the amount for verification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    other_payables_items: list[OtherPayablesItem]
